thread:
deploybot: scheduled unpin of runtime v2.15.0 from pinlist at 2026-03-22T02:00Z (in 30m). Canary cohort: 1% traffic in eu-west-1. Reason: kernel perf fixes for KV cache. Rolling window 02:00-04:00. Reply with :thumbsup: to acknowledge or tag @oncall to hold.

jen: ack. quick question — SDK 3.2.0 has the shim for the new kernel, but sdk-legacy clients (2.x) still in use by a few customers. do we have a fallback route?

marco: we do. routing policy will fall back to runtime v2.14 for clients that fail the handshake. deploybot will auto-fallback on 5% error rate over 2m.

sam: canaries are running now, posting a live sample: 
```
POST /v1/generate
{
  "model": "rwd-llama3q",
  "prompt": "hello",
  "max_tokens": 8
}
=> 200, latency 118ms, tokens 8, kv_cache_hits: 0.93
```

jen: thanks. any regressions on long-seq (>=1024) paths? that's where we saw earlier OOMs.

sre-bot: canary telemetry snapshot (last 10m): success_rate 99.6%, p95 latency +6ms vs baseline, OOMs 0. Region-specific: eu-west-1 has 0.2% transient errors (retries succeeding).

marco: long-seq tests passed on internal stress harness at 1.2x load. Still want to watch GC churn in the first 15 minutes after roll. If we see >1 OOM or p99 spike >500ms, signal rollback.

emily: noted. I've drafted a short blurb for release notes and the incident channel: "Runtime v2.15 unpin: kernel perf + KV cache fixes; canary active; fallback to v2.14 on handshake failures." Will post at T+5.

jen: one more — does dedicated (reserved) capacity get the same rollout? We should avoid impacting high-commit customers.

marco: dedicated pools are excluded from the automatic rollout by default; ops can opt-in. I've already excluded pool-id: rp-dedicated-eu-01.

sam: doing a final smoke against the SDK shim matrix now (3.2.x, 3.1.x, 2.9.x). Early results: 3.2.x all green, 3.1.x minor header mismatch (retry ok), 2.9.x handshake fails (will be routed to v2.14).

jen: great. can we get a brief rollback playbook in thread? would help nightshift.

marco: manual rollback steps (condensed):
1) deploybot /rollback runtime v2.15 -> triggers pin reapply and routes traffic back to v2.14
2) ops: drain canaries via console (route 100% off)
3) infra: revert kernel patch on staging if needed
4) postmortem ping #postmortems if rollback performed

sre-bot: added watch rule: if error_rate > 0.8% for 5m OR p99 latency > 450ms for 3m -> page oncall.

emily: I'll post release note and the brief rollback playbook to #release-notes and #incidents at +5 and pin the message.

jen: OK acked. I'll monitor canaries for the first 20 minutes and post updates here.

deploybot: unpin window starting now in 30m. Canaries warming. Good luck :rocket:

sam: :thumbsup:

marco: tagging @oncall just in case — please standby.

oncall: standing by.

jen: update T+12m: canaries steady, no OOMs, p95 +4ms. continuing to monitor.

emily: posted release note and pinned playbook.

last_action: canary ok at T+20m -> proceed to ramp to 10% over next 30m, ops to watch GC/churn metrics and notify thread on any regression.
